versions.changelog:
Initial release – Production-grade, SEO-optimized page and template generation skill.

- Supports creation and optimization of multiple page types (home, landing, product, category, blog, FAQ, etc.)
- Focuses on discoverability, clarity, and trustworthiness for both users and search/AI systems.
- Outputs clear page positioning, recommended SEO metadata, full page structure, and deployable copy.
- Includes real FAQ, schema guidance, technical SEO best practices, and a launch QA checklist.
- Enforces strict SEO/GEO best practices and mandates concise, professional, reusable outputs in Chinese.
